lines.t: Verse 1
When I wake and see the morning light
I feel Your mercy shining bright
In every breath, in every day
I see Your hand along my way
When I stumble, when I fall
You are there through it all
Even when I could not see
You were reaching out for me
Pre-Chorus
Before I ever called Your name
You were loving me the same
Chorus
I love You more than anything
More than all the world could bring
More than dreams my heart could hold
More than silver, more than gold
My love for You is strong and true
Every beat belongs to You
I love You more than anything
Because You first loved me
Verse 2
Through every tear and every fear
You were always standing near
When my faith was feeling small
You still held me through it all
You carried me when I was weak
Heard the prayers I couldn’t speak
Every step along my way
You have never walked away
Bridge
All my heart is Yours forever
Nothing could ever break this tether
In the dark, You are my light
In the storm, my calm, my guide
I am Yours and You are mine
Bound by love so pure, divine
Final Chorus (softer, then strong)
I love You more than anything
More than all the world could bring
And I know You loved me long ago
Before my heart had learned to know
My love for You is strong and true
Every breath I give to You
I love You more than anything
And I will for eternity
